posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina wished Rohit Shetty on his birthday amid rift rumors, while fans buzzing about her London return and pregnancy speculation with hubby Vicky Kaushal.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit unveiled the Sardaarji 3 trailer and dropped a new collaboration with AR Rahman and Imtiaz Ali. Also shared his MET Gala invite and Detective Sherdil release.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia addressed gender representation in Indian cinema at Cannes and is gearing up for action thriller Alpha. Also in talks for Tumbbad 3 and Disclosure Day.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka honored at the Gold Gala 2026 wearing a vintage 20-year-old Chikankari sari. Gearing up for survival thriller 'Reset' with Orlando Bloom and Mira Nair's 'Amri'.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK set to headline a big-budget romantic drama directed by Farah Khan after wrapping action thriller 'King'. War 2's pre-sales broke North America records in just 7 hours.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Bebo celebrated 25 years of 'Mujhe Kucch Kehna Hai' and is set to star in Salman Khan's superhero film directed by Raj & DK. Also completed filming for 'Daayra'.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha's dance video went viral across social media. She's starring in biopic 'Tamasha Samradini' and her Stree 2 continues to dominate with over Rs 307 crore at the box office.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is filming action sequences for Allu Arjun's 'Raaka' and SRK's 'King', using a body double for stunts during her second pregnancy with Ranveer Singh.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer's Don 3 exit controversy intensifies with FWICE issuing a non-cooperation directive. Meanwhile, his zombie thriller 'Pralay' begins filming in August 2026.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya dazzled at Cannes 2026 with a stunning swan-inspired ensemble and cosmic 'Luminara' couture, marking her 24th consecutive appearance at the festival.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika's romantic track 'Tujhko' from Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor is out. She also presented at the Global Anime Awards and joined Maddock's horror comedy universe.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha makes a fierce comeback with 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' — trailer shows her intense action avatar as a daughter-in-law with a secret past. Releasing June 19.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's 'Raaka' with Atlee and Deepika Padukone heats up with Deepika filming action scenes in Mumbai. His next project AA23 is also in the works.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's 'Peddi' trailer launched with AR Rahman's music and Janhvi Kapoor as co-star. The film releases June 4 in IMAX with massive North America pre-sales.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: War 2 with Hrithik Roshan set a record for fastest $100K pre-sales in North America. Jr NTR also premiered the 'Dragon' glimpse and Devara Part 2 poster on his birthday.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi is promoting 'Peddi' with Ram Charan ahead of its June 4 release. The film faced CBFC censorship for explicit content but is breaking North America ticket records.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's 'Chand Mera Dil' earned Rs 18.96 crore in six days with strong youth buzz. A dance scene went viral amid social media backlash, with dad Chunky defending her.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: New mom Kiara opened up about her postpartum journey with Sidharth Malhotra and shared adorable beach vacation photos with baby Saraayah. Also stars in War 2.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik's War 2 broke the fastest $100K pre-sales record in North America in just 7 hours. He also acquired Rs 10.9 crore in Mumbai commercial properties with dad Rakesh Roshan.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's comedy 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' with David Dhawan releases June 5. The 'Chunari Chunari' song with Pooja Hegde and Mrunal Thakur is generating buzz.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya dropped new track 'Prem Ki Leela' and made headlines with a luxury home purchase. Her All Hearts concert tour continues to sell out across India.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman composed the music for Ram Charan's blockbuster 'Peddi' and dropped a new collaboration with Diljit Dosanjh and Imtiaz Ali. The maestro stays unstoppable.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay has officially transitioned to politics after 'Jana Nayagan' as his farewell film. His cinema exit is expected to reshape the Tamil Nadu box office landscape.
